description: Set the turnout (mobilization) model. PRESIDENT (default, unchanged): each dial is a percentage-point boost toward toward_candidate_id in counties over an ACS threshold (college = >20% BA share, immig = >15%…

assumption.description: The modeling assumption in plain words (e.g. "youth demobilization scenario") — stored on the lever's audit entry.

clear.description: Race-scoped levels only: true removes every turnout (ballots) factor on this level and its set_turnout levers, returning ballots to the baseline. Vote-share edits stay. Do not combine with turnout_change_pct or a cohort.

counties.description: Alias of geo_ids for county cohorts.

criterion.description: ACS-style county matcher (statewide levels): e.g. {field:"population", op:"lt", value:30000} = rural counties. Filters WITHIN geo_ids when both are passed; scope a bare criterion with state_fips.

geo_ids.description: Explicit geography cohort — 5-digit county FIPS on statewide levels (e.g. "23005" = Cumberland ME), district external ids on house/state-leg, or precinct external ids (they contain a dash, e.g. "34013-0001") on any race level. Precinct ids apply at precinct grain where the scenario uses the canonical precinct baseline; ids that cannot take a factor are returned in excluded[] with a reason (never widened to a county). The receipt's precinct_impact lists the counties (and districts) that move.

level.description: president (default) = the classic ACS-threshold dials below. Any other level = the race-scoped ballots lever (turnout_change_pct + cohort).

source.description: Where this user-authored assumption came from (user statement, field report, or source citation) — stored on the lever's audit entry.

state_fips.description: 2-digit state FIPS to scope a criterion cohort to one state (e.g. "23" = Maine).

turnout_change_pct.description: Race-scoped levels only: percent change to BALLOTS cast in the matched geography (-12 = 12% fewer, +8 = 8% more). Composes multiplicatively with prior levers; the factor is clamped to [0.05, 5].

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: set_turnout
